opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Jud. Ct. Mass. (Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 900.) Motions of the American Parents Committee, Inc., and the Committee of Religious Leaders of the City of New York for leave to appear, as amici curiae, and to adopt as their briefs the briefs amicus curiae filed by the Citizens for Decent Literature, Inc., are granted.
